scope: Tunisia medical discovery — University of Sfax Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: The Faculty of Medicine of Sfax's official site describes pre-graduate medical studies and the Doctor of Medicine thesis process, and lists an online registration process for the 2026–27 academic year.
The official Faculty site explicitly states that it is 'on the path to accreditation,' rather than presenting completed programme accreditation.
The Faculty describes itself as part of the University of Sfax and reports 1,319 externs in 2021–22 and 184 graduates in 2021.

holdReasons: The Faculty's own current statement that accreditation is still in progress cannot support a completed recognition badge.
No current route-specific medicine tuition, admissions requirements/timeline, or international applicant evidence was established.
A complete degree-award, curriculum-duration, clinical placement, accommodation and international-support evidence packet was not completed.
nextAction: Wait for completed and independently verifiable programme accreditation, then obtain authoritative first-cycle medicine fee, admissions and clinical/student-support evidence before packaging.
